name: Naoise
text: Naoise is the modern Irish spelling of Noísiu, the lover of Deirdre. The dictionary keeps his full story under that spelling and treats Naisi as a variant of it.

attributes.attribute: name of the lover of Deirdre

okr.objective: Documents Naoise as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Naoise is the modern spelling of Noísiu.
He is the lover of Deirdre in the dictionary's routing.
